digest.component_or_area: autodeploy blue-green cutover gate for MCP
propositions: /health endpoint returns 200 without exercising the MCP request path, host allowlist check, or transport-security guard, allowing misconfigured containers to be promoted to production traffic
A container with REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS not admitting the public hostname passes /health 200 while returning 421 Invalid Host header to real MCP requests
The autodeploy.sh blue-green cutover flips the nginx upstream on /health 200 without ever issuing a test /mcp request, promoting containers that have never served one
The startup handshake must complete during ASGI lifespan startup before uvicorn accepts connections, and be reported on /health alongside store_status and in_flight to prove the request path works
The handshake drive must be bounded by a timeout and never raise or hang; failures are reported as failure records that prevent promotion via the deploy gate
